title: Onshore/Offshore Technician
description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY 
 We are currently seeking experienced Mechanical Technicians to support our client with industrial, offshore, and field operations throughout Newfoundland and Labrador. This role offers a combination of shop-based work, field assignments, and offshore projects supporting testing, commissioning, maintenance, and specialty mechanical services. Candidates with offshore experience, a strong mechanical background, and industrial trade experience are encouraged to apply 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 • Perform hydro testing, pressure testing, nitrogen pumping and testing activities. 
• Complete bolt torquing and tensioning operations. 
• Assist with chemical cleaning, flushing, and mechanical service work. 
• Service and maintain pumps, heat exchangers, and associated equipment. 
• Conduct equipment inspections and preventative maintenance. 
• Complete job-specific documentation, service reports, and safety paperwork. 
• Participate in toolbox talks, job hazard assessments, and safety meetings. 
• Operate industrial equipment and tools in accordance with safety procedures. 
• Travel to onshore, remote, and offshore worksites as required. 
• Support ongoing operational and project-based work throughout the year . 
 QUALIFICATIONS 
 REQUIRED 
 • 3-5 years of industrial or mechanical experience. 
• Strong mechanical aptitude. 
• Valid driver's licence with a clean driver's abstract. 
• Clear Certificate of Conduct. 
• Basic Survival Training (BST). (Can be provided) 
• Ability and willingness to travel for field and offshore assignments. 
• Ability to perform physically demanding work. 
 PREFERRED 
 • Offshore experience. 
• Journeyperson or apprentice Millwright. 
• Journeyperson or apprentice Pipefitter. 
• H2S Alive. 
• Offshore Medical. 
• Forklift certification. 
• Experience with pressure testing, chemical cleaning, bolting, hydro testing, or commissioning services. 
 WORKING CONDITIONS 
 • Shop hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM. 
• Field assignments may involve 12-hour shifts. 
• Offshore assignments may involve 12-hour shifts and rotational schedules. 
• Work may occur indoors, outdoors, at heights, and in various industrial environments. 
• Frequent lifting, pushing, pulling, climbing, and working around industrial equipment. 
 COMPENSATION 
 • Shop: $28-$30/hour 
• Field: $38-$40/hour 
• Offshore: $48-$50/hour 
 Compensation is based on experience, certifications, and assignment type . 
 SAFETY REQUIREMENTS 
 • Safety boots required. 
• Company PPE provided for shop and offshore work. 
• Candidates must follow all safety procedures, participate in safety meetings, and adhere to established safe work practices.

title: Heavy Duty Labourer
description:
We are currently seeking Part Time On-Call Heavy Duty Labourers to work with our clients in the St. Johns, Mount Pearl and surrounding areas. This would be a position which would include: 
 • Material Handling: Load, unload, and transport construction materials (e.g., bricks, timber, cement bags, piping) to and from work areas manually or using wheelbarrows and pallet jacks. 
• Site Preparation and Cleanup: Clean and prepare job sites by removing debris, trash, and potential hazards. Maintain a clean and safe work environment throughout the workday. 
• Manual Excavation: Dig trenches, bore holes, and backfill excavations using hand tools like shovels, rakes, and picks. Level earth to fine-grade specifications. 
• Assisting Tradespersons: Provide support to skilled workers such as carpenters, plumbers, bricklayers, and cement finishers with their tasks. This may include holding materials, fetching tools, and assisting with simple, non-specialized tasks. 
• Material Mixing: Mix, pour, and spread various materials such as concrete, asphalt, and mortar under direction. 
• Tool and Equipment Use: Operate various power and hand tools, such as pneumatic hammers, drills, saws, and tampers, as directed by the supervisor. Perform basic maintenance and cleaning of these tools. 
• Demolition Assistance: Assist in small-scale demolition projects using prying bars and other hand tools, sorting and piling salvaged materials for disposal or reuse. 
• Safety and Compliance: Adhere strictly to all company safety protocols and national health and safety regulations. Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) at all times and report any unsafe conditions or issues with equipment immediately. 
 WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT 
 • Prompt Weekly pay through direct deposit. 
• $1 6 - 21 /Hour depending on the job. 
• We work with your schedule. 
 REQUIREMENTS 
 • Physical Fitness: High level of physical fitness, strength, and stamina to perform strenuous manual labour, including lifting heavy objects (often in excess of 50 lbs), standing for long periods, bending, stooping, and kneeling in various weather conditions. Ability to lift over 50lbs. 
• Work Ethic: Reliable, punctual, and able to follow instructions carefully and efficiently with minimal supervision. 
• Teamwork: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a team. 
• Safety Awareness: Knowledge of construction site safety rules and procedures. 
• PPE: Steel Toed Boots , Hard Hat, Hi-Vis Safety Vest

title: Inventory Controller
description:
Inventory Controller 
 Location: Dartmouth, NS 
 Job Type: Full-Time | Permanent 
 Are you someone who likes knowing where things are, why the numbers don't match, and how to make an inventory process run more smoothly? 
 We're looking for an Inventory Controller to join a growing manufacturing operation and play an important role in keeping materials, components, and finished products moving efficiently. 
 This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable working with inventory data and ERP systems, but also enjoys working with production, purchasing, warehouse, and shipping teams to solve problems and keep things on track. 
 What you'll be doing 
 • Monitor inventory levels and help ensure materials are available when production needs them 
• Maintain accurate inventory records within the ERP/inventory management system 
• Complete regular cycle counts and support annual physical inventory counts 
• Investigate inventory discrepancies and work through the root cause 
• Receive and accurately record incoming materials and supplies 
• Track inventory moving between warehouse, production, and shipping 
• Work closely with production and purchasing to support material availability 
• Identify slow-moving, excess, or obsolete inventory 
• Assist with forecasting and replenishment planning 
• Prepare inventory reports and provide analysis to management 
• Ensure inventory transactions are accurate and completed on time 
• Help keep storage areas organized and inventory processes running efficiently 
• Look for opportunities to improve inventory accuracy and processes 
• Follow established safety and quality procedures 
 What we're looking for 
 You don't need to check every box, but we're looking for someone with: 
 • 5+ years of experience in inventory control, manufacturing, warehouse operations, or a related environment 
• Experience working with an ERP or inventory management system 
• Strong Excel skills and comfort working with data 
• Good attention to detail and a strong focus on accuracy 
• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills 
• The ability to investigate issues rather than simply identify them 
• Experience working with production, purchasing, warehouse, or supply chain teams 
• The ability to work independently while being a strong team player 
 A background in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field is an asset. 
 Experience with Modula Inventory Management System or SAGE 300 would be an advantage. 
 Why this role? 
 This is an opportunity to take ownership of an important part of the operation. Your work will directly support production by helping ensure the right materials are available, inventory records are accurate, and issues are identified and resolved before they become bigger problems. 
 If you enjoy working with numbers, systems, and people-and like being the person who can figure out why the inventory doesn't match - we'd like to hear from you. 
 Interested? Apply today!

Lead Foreman 
 Location: Lower Queensbury, NB

 About the Role 
 Our client is seeking an experienced and safety-focused Lead Foreman to oversee pavement marking projects and field crew s based out of Lower Queensbury, NB . This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for coordinating crews, scheduling work, inspecting completed work, managing equipment and materials, and serving as a key point of contact for customers and provincial representatives. 
 The ideal candidate is an experienced pavement marking or road construction professional who can confidently lead a team in the field while maintaining strong customer relationships, ensuring quality standards are met, and keeping projects organized and on schedule.
